b1.gazi_hunts_for_ryoka.news: Gazi of Reim put a sword to a half-Elf adventurer's throat in the street. A fleeing girl snared the adventurers in magic webs, and Gazi left the city.

canon_ref.note: Afternoon. Gerial lets slip Celum, Ryoka's inn and Esthelm. That evening Gazi tells Erin she will be away a while and asks her not to leave. Ceria burns the webs away with [Flashfire]. Delta is a design value.

b1.gazi_hunts_for_ryoka.summary: Gazi charms Gerial and Sostrom with her eye to learn where Ryoka is; Ceria shields her mind and refuses. When Ceria insults the King of Destruction, Gazi's sword is at her throat. A Watch whistle panics the invisible [Princess], whose ring snares the Horns in webs. Gazi leaves Liscor to hunt Ryoka.

canon_ref.note: Evening. [Hammer Blow] is Calruz's only Skill. He seems to know Gazi by sight. He wants to learn how to deal with Human women, thinking of Ryoka. Delta is a design value.

b1.calruz_shows_erin_hammer_blow.summary: Erin teaches Toren chess, and recalls a rhyme from her childhood: a king that moves soon dies. Calruz says she should have fought for Pawn. She has never heard of combat Skills, so he smashes a boulder with [Hammer Blow] and says he will train her for the two days before the ruins.

system.name: [Hammer Blow]
system.note: His only Skill, by his own word. It shatters a waist-high boulder.

system.name: Mostly a [Necromancer]
system.note: Ceria: perhaps Level 20+ as a pure [Mage], and he knows at least one Tier 4 spell. Expelled from Wistram for his experiments.

system.name: [Charm] with her eye
system.note: Gazers cast spells by looking. She is one of the King of Destruction's Seven.

system.name: Emerald ring of webs
system.note: Shoots sticky webbing as strong as stone. She also casts [Invisibility].
